findings.issue: Gentilic הַקֵּינִי is spelled as the scholar form qení; PROPER_NAMES.md locks no conventional Spanish ethnonym for H7017, so the referent is kept but the spelling is Hebraized.

notes: Other tokens match: 3ms saw, lifted his mashal, and said; verbless firm + 2ms seat; passive participle set in the crag; 2ms nest.
